items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: What did Babs Gonzales say? He said, “Kicks and no bread.”

ctx.x: Talk to me about the royalty arrangements on those European sessions.
There’s nothing to talk about, you don’t get any royalties. Just memories. What did Babs Gonzales say? He said, “Kicks and no bread.”
Do those European recordings benefit you in any way?
